transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I’m just tired all the time. 

By midmorning at work, even if I've just been reviewing files or walking a junior adjuster through a claim, it feels like my body and my brain are already running on empty. I just don't have the energy I should.
How have you been sleeping at night?

I sleep okay, I think. I mean, I haven't really noticed any problems with it. I usually go to bed at a normal time and get a full night's rest. It just doesn't really seem to make a dent in how tired I feel during the day.
Aside from feeling tired, have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I suppose I have. Most days, it just feels like there’s a gray film over everything. Even when good things are happening... like if my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I just kind of go through the motions. I don't really feel the enjoyment I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been quite a while now. I'd say... about three years and three months. It started right around the time I was moved into a higher-responsibility role at work. That was when they had me start mentoring the junior adjusters and overseeing our new workflow systems.
During these past three years, have there been any periods lasting more than two months where you felt completely back to your normal self?
No... no, I really don't think so. There haven't been any long breaks like that. It's pretty much just been this same constant feeling the whole time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty much the same. I haven't noticed any weight gain or loss or anything like that. I just eat like I normally do.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?

Yeah, I have. I just keep thinking that... well, this is just what the rest of my working life is going to be like. It's just going to be more audits and systems and pressure. I try to look ahead, but I really can't picture things ever feeling lighter again.
How has your self-esteem or confidence in yourself been during this time?

I haven't really noticed a change there. I mean, I know I'm capable at my job and everything. My confidence is fine, I guess. It's not really that I feel bad about myself... I just feel bogged down by everything else.
Have you ever experienced periods of time where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No, I can't say I have. I've never really had a period where I felt hyper or on top of the world like that. And I definitely always need my sleep. So, no, nothing like what you're describing.
